Online reservations and discount price available up to 24 hours prior to your visit date. Same day rentals are available at the Snack Bar Cabana window at the gate price, first come first served. Cabana rentals are limited, so advanced reservation are recommended. Cabanas do not include waterpark admission. Online reservations for Day rentals only.
